newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair cuts Euro fares 50 pct, in Nov/Dec.
newsitem.headline: Swissair cuts Euro fares 50 pct, in Nov/Dec.

text.p: Swissair AG said it was cutting its fares to 32 destinations in 18 countries, mainly in Europe, for flights between November 8 and December 8 by around 50 percent.
Swissair said in a statement that the fare cut was partially in reaction to the prices of other carriers and a way to stimulate business in the normally-slow month of November.
"We want to stimulate European traffic in the generally weak travel month of November," Swissair's head of marketing in Switzerland Martin Isler was quoted as saying.
Swissair's fares range from 199 Swiss francs to 399 francs with departure from Zurich, Basle or Geneva.
The restriction is that the passenger spends three nights in the destination or the night between Saturday and Sunday.
